prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin to establish rules for [finish, new_flow], [finish, new_screen], [sign_in, notification], and [sign_in, reorder] since each kind of change has only one test so far.
Evidence for [adoption, new_flow] is mixed across 2 tests: one test won (+7.6% after noise correction), while the other showed no clear effect (-1.6% after noise correction).
Evidence for [finish, redesign] is mixed across 2 tests: one test won (+5.5% after noise correction), while the other showed no clear effect (-1.2% after noise correction).
Evidence for [adoption, redesign] is mixed across 2 tests: one test stopped early (-8.3% after noise correction), while the other showed no clear effect (+0.7% after noise correction).
Predictions were consistently too low for winning tests across all rounds.
Predictions were usually too high for tests that stopped early or showed no clear effect, though round 11 was an exception.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +2.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -3.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: +10.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +2.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -8.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 64.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 79.4%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Companion Path Redesign: Redesigns the story and path selection flow into a full-bleed story scroll layout with interactive decision cards. (why: The choose_path step loses 23.8% of users with a high mean duration of 514 seconds, showing confusion or hesitation early in the funnel.)
1: [sign_in, layout] Multi Provider Auth Button Grid Layout: Reorganizes sign-in options into a clean two-column grid layout with highlighted provider buttons. (why: Sign-in converts at 72.9% and support received reports of sign-in screens stalling or failing to load clearly.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Personality Quiz Screen: Adds a new pet personality quiz screen before pet selection to help users find their ideal companion match. (why: Adoption has a steep 35.3% drop-off rate and takes an average of 1017 seconds, pointing to friction in pet decision making.)
3: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Activity Log Progress Info: Adds animated progress status bars and explicit backend pet rendering estimates to the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has an extremely high mean time of 2336 seconds (median 201s), leaving users unsure if pet creation is working.)
4: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion Interaction Playground Flow: Adds a dedicated interactive testing screen where users practice summoning, hiding, and talking to their pet before arriving home. (why: Multiple support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet on the desktop.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Lighting and Angle Capture Hint: Displays specific guidance hints on the photo upload screen recommending clear front lighting and neutral backgrounds. (why: Support logs contain emails reporting custom pet generation failures or distorted custom pet models.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Readiness System Tray Notification: Enables system tray notification opt-in on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes. (why: Because waiting times average over 38 minutes (2336s), users switch away and need an alert when setup finishes.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Companion Path Outcome Clarity Headline: Reword the choose_path headline and body text to clearly describe the outcome and estimated time of each path. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path with a median of 8s but mean of 514s, indicating confusion over what each option provides.)
